Thank you so much to everyone who joined us in North County and South City today to make our Spring Canvass Kickoff a success!

Together, we’re building the momentum we need to win in August by organizing our communities and having conversations about the issues that matter to the people of St. Louis.

I’m so proud to have the movement with me as I campaign to go back to Congress to stand up against Trump, abolish ICE, lower costs, and keep delivering for STL.

I had a great time yesterday joining Realtist of Metropolitan St. Louis for an amazing conversation on housing policy, home ownership, and community engagement. Access to affordable and sustainable housing remains a critical component of building a truly equitable and democratic society.

Thank you so much to NAREB for your work to advance housing justice and foster sustainable homeownership in St. Louis and around the country!

STL-DSA Canvass:
When 👉 TOMORROW, (4/18), @ 11:00am
Where 👉 Tower Grove Park (Near the Sons of Rest Pavilion)
RSVP Link: act.stldsa.org/dsa-for-cori-…

Spring Canvass Kickoff:
When 👉 TOMORROW, (4/18), @ 11:00am
Where 👉 Hunny's Cafe & Wine at 7312 Natural Bridge Rd, St. Louis, MO 63121
RSVP Link: mobilize.us/coribush1/event/…

TOMORROW (4/18) @ 11:00 AM:

Join Cori and the team for our Spring Canvass Kickoff in North County!

OR

Join STL-DSA to canvass for Cori in Tower Grove South!

Together, we’ll build the momentum we need to win in August and send a true representative of the people of St. Louis back to Congress.

Volunteers who join us in North County will be able to claim their free Cori Bush t-shirt and yard sign before heading out to organize our community.

Thank you sis @RepPressley for your leadership ✨


Congresswoman Rashida Tlaib (@RepRashida)

I am so proud of my sis @RepPressley for securing 218 signatures on her discharge petition to extend Haiti TPS.

She is a fearless leader that our nation deserves in this moment.

I’m voting YES to protect our Haitian neighbors.



— https://nitter.net/RepRashida/status/2044736607039705105#m

When 👉 Saturday, April 18th, @ 11:00am 

Where 👉 Hunnys Cafe & Wine at 7312 Natural Bridge Rd, St. Louis, MO 63121

RSVP Link: mobilize.us/coribush1/event/…

THIS SATURDAY!

Join Cori and the team for our Spring Canvass Kickoff in North County! T-shirts and signs will be provided to canvassers.

No experience required! Our kickoff will begin with a training to ensure that volunteers have everything they need to talk with neighbors about sending a true fighter for STL back to Congress.

Despite unprecedented spending by AIPAC and other groups, our race is virtually tied.

Even after millions of dollars from AIPAC, defense contractors, Big Real Estate, and several other corporate PACs, the people of St. Louis aren’t convinced by the job that the incumbent is doing.

That’s because instead of standing up for STL, his voting record has reflected the interests of his MAGA billionaire donors.

How does our grassroots campaign close that gap? It starts with you: Join us as we build t

Where 👉 Hunny's Cafe & Wine at 7312 Natural Bridge Rd, St. Louis, MO 63121

RSVP Link: mobilize.us/coribush1/event/…

THIS SATURDAY:

Join Cori and the team for our Spring Canvass Kickoff in North County to claim your free Cori t-shirt and sign!

Claim your purple Cori shirt and your Cori sign before talking with members of our community in North County about fighting Trump, abolishing ICE, and delivering for St. Louis!

Special interests, like war profiteers and Big Pharma, will always back the politicians who they know will give them a return on their investment.

That’s why my opponent takes money from AIPAC, ICE contractors, and the utility companies that are driving up our costs here in St. Louis.

I’m running a people-powered campaign that will deliver for US, not the billionaires or MAGA Republicans who are spending big to try to stop our movement.

Together, we’ll talk to neighbors across the St. Louis area to build the movement!

Fighting back against Trump starts with opposing his agenda, voting to impeach him, and holding his entire administration accountable.

But politicians who share the same MAGA billionaire donors as Trump can’t fight the president because they are bankrolled by the same PACs.

I’ll fight to stop Trump’s agenda, end his illegal wars, and abolish ICE, because I don’t take money from the same people who put him in the White House.

Video

Join Cori and the team for our Spring Canvass Kickoff!

Together, we'll meet in North County to talk with our neighbors and community members about standing up to Trump, fighting back against ICE, and delivering for the people of St. Louis.

When 👉 Saturday, April 18th, @ 11:00am
Where 👉 North County (specific location to come soon)

Zero canvassing experience required. Whether you’re highly experienced or new to the movement, we need YOU to help us build momentum between now and August 4th to s

The political moment we’re in right now calls for bold leadership. Our movement can’t stop now.

I’m going back to Congress to finish what I started: enshrine the right to an abortion in the Constitution, deliver reparations for the descendants of enslaved Africans, create a Medicare for All system, abolish ICE, achieve real accountability in policing, and so much more.
